display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GET /api/audio/search?q=…&limit=…
q is a required @RequestParam — a missing q 400s in Spring before this flow

div.style: color: rgb(74, 58, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: @PreAuthorize hasAuthority('audio:read')

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: q null or blank?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
normalized = q.trim()
effectiveLimit = 20 when limit is null or ≤ 0, else min(limit, 100)
SEARCH_PREFILTER_LIMIT fixed at 2000

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MediaSearchSqlBuilder.tokenize(normalized)
split on whitespace, drop tokens with no letter or digit,
dedupe preserving order — no lowercasing, SQL does that

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: any tokens survived?

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Return List.of() — 200 OK, empty array
early return, so NO SEARCH audit row is written

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MediaSearchSqlBuilder.build over AUDIO_SEARCH_SPEC
one CTE per token, binding q0..qN escaped for LIKE
plus qRaw0..qRawN raw for similarity

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Entity leg: SELECT e.id FROM audios e
WHERE e.removed_at IS NULL AND three probes per column
over 46 columns — LIKE 'q%', LIKE '%q%', and LOWER(col) % qRaw

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
UNION child legs: audio_genres.genre, audio_contributors.contributor,
audio_tags.tag, audio_keywords.keyword
same three probes — these tables have no removed_at to filter on

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LIMIT 2000 bounds the whole UNION for that token,
so worst-case work is fixed regardless of table size

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
pg_trgm GIN on LOWER(col) gin_trgm_ops — idx_audios_origin_title_trgm,
idx_audios_speaker_trgm, idx_audio_tags_tag_trgm, idx_audio_keywords_keyword_trgm
btree LOWER(col) text_pattern_ops — idx_audios_origin_title_pat for 1-2 char prefixes
btree FK — idx_audio_tags_audio_id for the phase-2 subqueries

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SELECT e.* FROM audios e
JOIN t0_cands ... JOIN tN_cands ON cands.id = e.id
inner joins are the AND across tokens

div.style: color: rgb(74, 58, 18) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
WHERE e.removed_at IS NULL — applied AGAIN on the outer select
only the entity leg carried the predicate, so a trashed audio can still
enter a CTE through a tag, keyword, genre or contributor hit
this outer predicate is what removes it

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ORDER BY tier 1 DESC then tier 2 DESC
count of tokens prefix-matching, then substring-matching,
any of the 14 rankPrimaryCols (origin_title, audio_code, speaker, poet, ...)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
tier 3 DESC: sum over tokens of GREATEST of
similarity on each primary column and
COALESCE(MAX(similarity(child value)), 0) per child table
tie-break e.id ASC

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: LIMIT effectiveLimit

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
EntityManager native query → rows materialised as Audio (AudioReadCache is bypassed),
mapped by toResponse, then AudioAuditService.record with AudioAuditAction.SEARCH
logging q, tokens, limit and hit count

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 200 OK — ranked List of AudioResponseDTO

div.style: color: rgb(92, 32, 24) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
403 Forbidden — ErrorCode.ACCESS_DENIED
ApiExceptionHandler echoes requiredAuthority audio:read
